artworks.title: Part of the Last Judgment from Michael Angelo
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of muscular, nude human figures intertwined in various poses. Their bodies are bent and twisted in a dynamic composition, with limbs interlocking. The figures show a high level of muscular definition, showcasing the artist's skill in depicting the human form. They occupy most of the space, creating movement and tension. Shading and lines contribute to a three-dimensional appearance, adding depth and contrast to the composition.

artworks.title: Holy Family, from Michelangelo
artworks.artist: Henry Noel Humphreys after John Flaxman
artworks.description: The image shows three figures portrayed from their lower bodies to heads. In the center is a seated woman facing away with her head turned slightly. She has a bun hairstyle and a serene expression. She wears a flowing gown. Behind her is an older man with a full beard looking contemplative and possibly guiding a child on the woman's shoulder. The child reaches forward and is depicted unclothed. The background is a blank expanse.

artworks.title: Last Judgment, Lincoln Cathedral
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing featuring a central seated figure surrounded by various other figures and elements in an ornate, symmetrical composition. The central figure holds a book and gestures with their hand. Other figures, some angelic, are arranged around the central figure, ascending and descending along arched paths, with some guided or judged by angels. The drawing has detailed line work that emphasizes form and expression, creating a celestial atmosphere reminiscent of religious iconography.

artworks.title: Figure from Peterborough Cathedral
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright in a frontal pose. The individual faces forward with a serene expression and a slightly tilted head. They have a veil covering their head and are wearing long, textured robes that fall to the ground. The person's right hand is raised in a gesture, while their left hand rests by their side. The background is a plain, shaded area that contrasts with the figure.

artworks.title: An Apostle, from Albert [sic] Durer
artworks.artist: James Henry Lynch after John Flaxman
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a side profile. The figure is upright, facing left, holding a cross with both hands, and a rolled parchment is tucked between the arm and chest. The person has a prominent nose, a thick white beard, and curly hair. They wear a flowing robe that reaches their bare feet. The person appears to be barefoot. The background is plain with light shading and shadows cast behind them.

artworks.title: Drapery
artworks.description: The image displays abstract lines and shapes that curve and flow with a sense of movement. The shapes resemble draped fabric or flowing water, with some lines cascading in a wave-like pattern. There are elongated curves that hang gracefully like curtains or the folds of a gown, giving a sense of lightness and fluidity. The arrangement of the lines suggests undulating motion, creating a connection to familiar objects such as flowing cloth or rolling waves.

artworks.title: Drapery, Three Figures, a Bacchante and Two From Nature
artworks.artist: Henry Noel Humphreys after John Flaxman
artworks.description: The image depicts three sketched figures. In the upper portion, a nude person is shown in a dynamic pose with one leg forward and arms stretched outward. The figure is bald and facing left, surrounded by swirling fabric. Below, there are two full-body figures. One figure is viewed from behind, draped in layers of fabric, with hair in a bun. The other figure faces left, wearing a long garment that follows the body's line, with hair in an updo. The background is a light surface with pencil marks and annotations, indicating it is a sketch.

artworks.title: Juno Lucina
artworks.description: The sculpture shows a standing figure covered in a long robe, with bare feet and a hand holding a scroll. The figure's head is turned slightly to the left, with a serene expression. The sculpture is monochromatic, likely made of stone. The portrayal of the human figure is life-sized and conveys formal dignity and grace.

artworks.title: Head of Our Savior, from Arringhi's "Roma Subterranea"
artworks.artist: Henry Noel Humphreys after John Flaxman
artworks.description: The image shows an individual with long, wavy hair, wearing a robe and holding a closed book or tablet. They have a serene expression and are surrounded by a circular halo.

artworks.title: Reverend John Upton
artworks.description: The image shows a man in profile facing right, showing the upper half of his body. He has European facial features, curly hair reaching his shoulders, and is dressed in a historical coat with a high collar and buttons. His left hand is partially visible. The background is plain, with a handwritten note and title at the bottom giving his name as Rev. John Upton and details about the sketch's creation and publication.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Gentleman
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on papier colle
artworks.description: The image is a portrait focusing on the upper half of a man's body, from the waist up. The man is positioned facing slightly to the viewer's right but looking straight ahead with his arms crossed. His facial features include strong eyebrows, a pointed nose, and a thoughtful expression. His hair is curly and styled away from his face. The man is dressed in a formal coat with a high-collared shirt underneath. No jewelry is visible, and there are no objects in his hands. The background of the portrait is a textured monochrome pattern which contrasts with the sepia tone of the surrounding area, and the image is framed within a larger blank matting that has a decorative border.

artworks.title: Antonio Canova
artworks.description: This image shows a sketch of a man in profile view, with his body angled slightly to the left. The man has distinct facial features and textured hair with waves and curls. He is wearing a high-collared shirt, jacket, and there are no visible objects in his hands. The background is plain, and there are handwritten annotations near the bottom right corner of the image.

artworks.title: Britannia Crowning History
artworks.artist: Charles Grignion, after Conrad Martin Metz
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring classical figures amid clouds. The central elements include a winged figure in the sky blowing a trumpet, calling attention to a group of classical figures among the clouds below. There is a figure seated on a chariot adorned with a round shield, gesturing with a laurel branch towards another figure writing or reading a document with focused attention. Nearby, an armored figure stands with a spear, while a blindfolded figure holds a set of scales. The composition includes symbolic objects such as ship's sails, scrolls, and scientific instruments like a compass and a globe in the foreground. The detailed line work and shading give the drawing a sense of depth and movement, consistent with classical artistic traditions.

artworks.title: Holy Family? with Angels l.1: The March of the Intellect
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint in brown on papier colle
artworks.description: The image features a pencil drawing of a group of figures. In the center, a seated figure holds a child close to their chest. Another standing child leans into the seated figure. Surrounding them are three winged figures, resembling angels, who appear to be watching over the central figures. The angels have long robes and gentle expressions. The background is plain and unadorned, drawing focus to the group in the center.

artworks.title: Holy Family? with Angels
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures in near-full body view. In the center, a seated figure, likely a woman, wears a flowing gown and holds an infant cradled in her arms. Two angelic figures with wings and flowing robes flank the central figures. Another child stands beside the seated woman with one arm around her leg. The figures are sketched with soft shading against a plain background. There are no visible objects or jewelry in the composition.

artworks.title: The Last Supper
artworks.description: This print shows thirteen men sitting at a long table covered with a tablecloth, depicted by thin, dark lines. The men are shown from the knees up, seated on one side of the table across from us. A central man with long hair and a beard is surrounded by others engaged in conversation or gestures. The men wear draped robes and exhibit various styles of facial hair. All but one have halos around their heads, and rays of light shine upwards from the head of the central man. Objects on the table include plates, cups, and bread. The background features paneled walls, windows, and a ceiling with visible beams. The background of the print is off-white paper.

artworks.title: Frontispiece for the Penny Magazine of the Society for the Diffusion of Knowledge: Vo
artworks.description: This drawing features various illustrations for a magazine frontispiece. The captions indicate different fields of study such as Astronomy, Geography, Navigation, Natural History, Botany, Agriculture, Mathematics, Divinity, Philosophy, Physics, Mineralogy, and Literature. Allegorical imagery shows the benefits of knowledge with the central title "The March of Intellect," an emblem labeled the "Wool Sack," and a figure underneath with the words “Progress” and “Liberty.” A depiction of "The Penny Trumpeter" symbolizes spreading information. This artwork aims to enrich public understanding through access to diverse subjects.

artworks.title: Invitation? with Aerial View of Regent's Park
artworks.description: This image shows an aerial view of an urban area with buildings, tree-lined avenues, and roads. The horizon is near the top, with buildings extending into the distance. In the center, a road labeled "Park Road" curves through the scene, near a green area. Toward the left, there is a convergence of streets labeled "Upper Baker St" and "New Road," surrounded by buildings. The brushstrokes are detailed, capturing architectural details and tree textures. The color palette is monochromatic, with various shades of black and white highlighting urban design intricacies.

artworks.title: Her Majesty Leaving Buckingham Palace, June 28, 1838 [left half]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a ceremonial event at Buckingham Palace. A grand horse-drawn carriage is depicted leaving an ornate gate, surrounded by a lively crowd. The illustration shows a procession scene with numerous figures dressed in period attire, waving and cheering. The detailed architecture of the gate is visible, showcasing decorative elements and a large flag flying atop the structure. The scene is enhanced by trees and cloudy skies in the background.

artworks.title: Crowning of Queen Victoria, June 28, 1838 [right half]
Holyrood Abbey
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed illustration of Holyrood Abbey from a slightly lowered vantage point. The front of the ruined structure is visible, with soft, billowy clouds in the sky. The brushstrokes create texture in the stone of the abbey and the ground. Two figures in period clothing are nearby, providing scale. The color palette is monochrome, using brown and beige shades for shadows and highlights. The sky hints at an early evening or overcast setting.

artworks.title: Peg Woffington
artworks.medium: etching in brown on papier colle
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a woman. She is facing slightly to her right with a calm expression, arched eyebrows, and full lips. She has dark hair styled in soft curls and wears a lace headpiece. The woman is dressed in a garment with lace trim and a ribbon or choker around her neck. She also wears drop earrings. The background is dark and textured.

artworks.title: Lady Maria Hooker When Miss Turner at Age Seventeen
artworks.artist: Mary Dawson Turner, after Thomas Phillips
artworks.description: This is a portrait drawing of a young woman with curly hair flowing down to her shoulders. She is facing forward in a seated position with a slight turn to her right. The drawing shows her delicate facial features, including soft eyes and full lips. She is wearing a dress with a high neckline, visible shoulder outlines, and possibly decorative detailing on the bodice. The drawing is an intricate line sketch set against a lightly textured, plain background, emphasizing the subject.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Young Gentleman Surrounded by Cupids; Lord Byron?
artworks.description: The image displays a bust of a man surrounded by a decorative arrangement. The person is depicted from the chest up and is in a semi-profile position, slightly turned to the right. His facial features include a defined nose, full lips, and his gaze directed upward. He has curly hair styled with volume, and sideburns that frame his face. The man is wearing formal attire with a high-collared shirt and an ascot, accompanied by a double-breasted coat with visible buttons. Surrounding him are three cherubic figures with wings, two to his left and one to his right, engaged in playful poses. Next to the cherub on the right is a harp. The background features an arrangement of what appears to be floral garlands. The engraving is set against a textured, plain background with faint speckles or marks.
